page.layout: One page of text. Page number at the top centre. Below it, a decorative headpiece, then the title in two lines and a centred subtitle. Then the verse with a woodcut initial R at the left. A single letter "T" sits at the right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.l: linqueret arua, Laurigera Paci cedere iussa lo-
cum, Tro meritis Dea cuique dedit sua

l.i: Ante omnes socios speciali affecit honore
Gens ea plus reliquis, plus quàm feralis Erinnys
Præstitit, in Dominos tota animosa[?] suos.)
Conductumq;, dedit salutem loca cuncta adeundi,
Hoc dono lætata magis quàm munere Clympi
Turba fuit, patrias quod datum adire domos.
Sed simulac Stygias tandem penetrasset ad oras,
Terribilis tristi vox Acheronte data est:
Hinc fuge dira lues, qua nil truculentius[?] unquam
Exstitit, hic tuto non licet esse tibi.
Imperat hic solus Mundi aduersarius, at tu
Non solum Mundi, ast antagonista Dei.
Ille timet Dominum rerum cui summa potestas,
At tibi non hominum cura, nec ulla Dei.

page.notes: Woodcut initial R at the left of the verse, joined to "ANCORVM" as "RANCORVM". Headpiece is decoration, not transcribed. "Clympi" is printed with a C-like initial and probably stands for "Olympi"; kept as printed. "animosa" is hard to read in the scan and is marked [?]. "truculentius" is partly obscured and is marked [?]. "Tro" is printed as seen. The letter "T" at the foot is treated as a catchword; it may instead be a printer's mark.
